Definition: Oreb, the name of a Midianite and of the cliff near the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Oreb = "raven"; n pr m; 1) one of the chieftains of the Midianite army defeated by Gideon; n pr loc; 2) a rock east of the Jordan where Oreb and part of his army fell to the Ephraimites
